title: Austin: First Taxis, Tax Fixes, New Firemen
summary:
*   **Early Transportation:** Approved the operation of a "service car," an early form of private for-hire transport similar to a taxi or rideshare service.
*   **Property Valuation:** Fixed the assessed value of a major land and town company's property at $36,977 for tax purposes.
*   **Public Safety:** Confirmed the appointment of two new hosemen to the Austin Fire Department, strengthening local emergency services.
*   **Tax Correction:** Authorized a small refund of $8.42 for a business due to an administrative error of a double assessment on personal property.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, January 22, 1920.

The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; absent, none.
Service Car
Jas. E. Ryones

The application of Jas. E. Ryones to operate a service car was granted by the following
vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; nays, none.
Fixing Value
M. K. & T. L. & T. Co.
$36,977.00

Councilman Haynes moved that the assessment of the M.K.& T. Land & Town Company’s property
be placed at $36,977.00, value as fixed by the Board of Equalization for the year 1918.
Motion carried by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes
and Ward, 5; nays, none.

The Council then adjourned.
Jas. H. Formsby City Clerk.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, January 22, 1920.

The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; absent, none.

The minutes of the last meeting were read and unanimously adopted. Floyd Smith
Elect. Sign

The application of Floyd Smith to erect a new electrical sign at No. 400 Congress Avenue
was referred to the city electrician. Appt.
A. J. Hamilton
and Davis Cotell
Firemen

Upon the recommendation of C. L. Woodward, Chief of the Fire Department, Councilman Alford
nominated A. J. Hamilton and Davis Cotell to be hosemen in the Austin Fire Department to
succeed Harper Nations and August Von Rosenberg. Nominations were confirmed by the
following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Graham, Haynes and Ward, 4; nays, none -
Councilman Alford present but not voting.

Councilman Haynes introduced the following resolution: BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Refund %
Double Assessment
Doole & Sons

That whereas, the statement of Fred Sterzing, Tax Collector, herewith attached, shows a
double rendition of personal property for the year 1919, one by Doole & Sons and one by
David Doole, Jr., and that they are entitled to a refund of $8.42 on one of said
renditions, Therefore, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS:
That the City Clerk be instructed to issue a warrant for that amount to Doole & Sons out
of the General Contingent Fund, and that the Assessor and Collector be authorized to
cancel one of the assessments on his rolls and to take credit therefor.

The above resolution was adopted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen
Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; nays, none.

The Council then recessed.
